note: The RHB credit card lists, conventional and Islamic. Each card is one div.card-root inside div.product-card-listing, with its h3 name and a link to the card page. The tiles are all in the HTML; the category tabs only show or hide them with Alpine x-show. The fees and income come from the fees accordion on each card page. Apply buttons go to product.apply.rhbgroup.com forms, which are not read.
